title: Validation/Dissemination Of A Temporal Bone Dissection Simulator
brief_summary: Designed to test the efficacy of a computer based virtual simulation for teaching ear surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Enrolled in residency for ear, nose and throat training or medical student interested in ear, nose and throat training.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not enrolled in ENT training program or interest in ENT training.
